headings.usage: Use for all H1-H6 tags, massive typographic reveals, and numbers. Ensure tight tracking (tracking-tight).

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, descriptions, and small labels. Clean and readable.

visual_enhancers.motion: Framer Motion for scroll reveals. Use 'whileInView' with 'viewport={{ once: true, margin: "-100px" }}'. Use mask-image line-by-line reveals for hero text.
visual_enhancers.scrolling: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is mandatory for the premium feel.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for the editorial slow ticker. Golden outline text over deep green background.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(212, 201, 66, 0.2) or solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1) for subtle structure. Use accent_gold for active/hover states.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid excessive gradients. Use solid #284525 with grain/noise overlays or subtle radial glows using rgba(212, 201, 66, 0.05).

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4C942] text-[#284525] font-bold px-8 py-4 rounded-full hover:bg-[#E5DA53] transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#D4C942] text-[#D4C942] font-semibold px-8 py-4 rounded-full hover:bg-[#D4C942]/10 transition-colors duration-300

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding.
layouts.grid: Bento grids for 'Why NextZGames' (6 cards) and 'How It Works'. Asymmetric layouts for text + image sections.
layouts.hero: Kinetic layout. Large typography overlapping or interacting with the smartphone mockup. Parallax effect on the image.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup 'lenis' for smooth scrolling.
Install 'framer-motion' for scroll-reveals and line-by-line text animations.
Strictly follow the homepage section order defined in the problem statement.
Ensure 'Plus Jakarta Sans' is used for headings and 'Inter' for body. Import from Google Fonts.
Keep backgrounds restricted to shades of #284525. Do not use generic black or blue.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-download-btn').
Avoid generic casino tropes (no red, no chips raining, no neon). Stick to sophisticated green and gold.
Ensure the hero has a masked text reveal (e.g., overflow-hidden on wrapper, y-translate on text) to give it an Awwwards feel.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, and custom selection states elevate the design.
accessibility: Maintain contrast ratios. Gold text on green background is accessible, but ensure white text on green meets WCAG AA.
Support prefers-reduced-motion for Framer Motion animations.
Provide aria-labels for buttons and icons.
